Step1: Spray WD-40 on the rusted chain and let it soak a few minutes to loosen the rust (WD-40).
Step2: Wearing thick gloves, flex and work the links back and forth by hand until supple; use the flathead screwdriver to pry the chain onto the sprocket teeth, then turn the pedal to seat it (gloves, screwdriver).
Step3: Wipe off excess and apply dry lubricant (dry lube).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

Step2: Use the long-bristled brush (or wicker broom) to sweep the plush toy off the edge; its bristles grip the fuzz better than the hanger. Alternatively tie the yoga strap around the hanger to extend reach.
